dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical linear narrowing of the body width from the mid-section to the posterior terminus.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median pixel intensity consistent with a uniform light-grey skin tone across the visible dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency clusters of subtle, darker grey pixels distributed unevenly across the mid-dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the light-grey baseline and localized darker mottled clusters.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Distinct set of parallel, high-reflectance linear marks located on the mid-dorsal axis and one high-contrast dark point on the anterior right lateral margin.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Linear longitudinal shadow along the posterior dorsal midline indicating a topographical ridge or depression.
